cues: The electrons flow through the metal to the rim, where oxygen dissolves easily.
There, oxygen is reduced with hydrogen ions from dissolved carbon dioxide.
The iron two ions drift outwards and are oxidised further to hydrated iron three oxide, rust.
Rust is flaky and porous, so it does not protect the iron beneath, and corrosion runs right through.
